_comment: Plugin/skill-id renames across marketplace versions — the data /sdlc:doctor migrates a project's config with (parallel to agent-migrations.json, but keyed on a `plugin:skill` id rather than a bare agent name, since the token shape differs). THIS IS NOT A RUNTIME ALIAS TABLE: nothing resolves an id through it at dispatch or prompt assembly. It exists so a rename is a one-time, visible, approved edit to the user's own files. `skill_renames` maps the OLD fully-qualified `plugin:skill` id to the NEW one.

migrations.reason: ADR-0026 — the 7 additive Android framework plugins were embedded into android-foundation's manifest.yaml `frameworks:` array; their skills moved under android-foundation's own skill namespace.
ADR-0026 — embedded into android-foundation. The one divergent case: plugin name and skill name were never the same (dagger-plugin ships the hilt-conventions skill).
